claims.text: The authors propose two new unsupervised representation-learning objectives: Sequential Denoising Autoencoders (SDAEs) and FastSent.
SDAEs perform well on paraphrase identification tasks, while FastSent excels in unsupervised benchmarks like the SICK sentence relatedness task.
